```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

set.seed(1031)
```

## Synthetic data

The data below are simulated for visual reconstruction only. Each sample sums to 100% relative abundance.

```{r data}
diet_groups <- c(
  "Psy", "Med", "Jap", "Keto", "Veg", "Pec",
  "LF", "West", "Inu", "Amer", "Asp", "HF"
)

families <- c(
  "Erysipelotrichaceae",
  "Lachnospiraceae",
  "Atopobiaceae",
  "Muribaculaceae",
  "Akkermansiaceae",
  "Bacteroidaceae",
  "Bifidobacteriaceae",
  "Clostridiaceae",
  "Eubacterium_coprostanoligenes_group",
  "Lactobacillaceae",
  "Peptococcaceae",
  "Peptostreptococcaceae",
  "Ruminococcaceae",
  "Oscillospiraceae",
  "Staphylococcaceae",
  "Streptococcaceae",
  "Sutterellaceae",
  "Others"
)

samples_per_group <- 5
group_gap <- 1.80

sample_table <- expand.grid(
  group = diet_groups,
  replicate = seq_len(samples_per_group),
  KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) |>
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = diet_groups)
  ) |>
  arrange(group, replicate) |>
  mutate(
    sample_index = row_number(),
    plot_x = sample_index + (as.integer(group) - 1) * group_gap,
    ici_score = scales::rescale(sample_index, to = c(0.08, 0.96)),
    sample = sprintf("S%02d", sample_index)
  )

base_shape <- c(
  6.0, 4.1, 2.2, 3.4, 1.1, 1.4, 1.6, 1.2, 0.8,
  1.7, 1.0, 1.4, 1.1, 1.7, 0.8, 0.7, 1.0, 1.5
)

group_effect <- matrix(
  exp(rnorm(length(diet_groups) * length(families), 0, 0.38)),
  nrow = length(diet_groups),
  dimnames = list(diet_groups, families)
)

# Add broad group-level ecological signatures.
group_effect["Keto", c("Lachnospiraceae", "Atopobiaceae")] <- c(3.5, 2.3)
group_effect["Veg", c("Lachnospiraceae", "Muribaculaceae")] <- c(2.4, 2.0)
group_effect["Pec", c("Lactobacillaceae", "Bifidobacteriaceae")] <- c(3.0, 2.1)
group_effect["LF", c("Erysipelotrichaceae", "Bacteroidaceae")] <- c(2.7, 2.0)
group_effect["West", c("Peptostreptococcaceae", "Ruminococcaceae")] <- c(2.6, 2.1)
group_effect["Inu", c("Bifidobacteriaceae", "Lactobacillaceae")] <- c(3.3, 2.1)
group_effect["Amer", c("Muribaculaceae", "Akkermansiaceae")] <- c(2.2, 2.0)
group_effect["Asp", c("Erysipelotrichaceae", "Lactobacillaceae")] <- c(2.5, 2.7)
group_effect["HF", c("Streptococcaceae", "Oscillospiraceae")] <- c(3.2, 2.0)

composition_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(sample_table)), function(i) {
  group_name <- as.character(sample_table$group[i])
  score <- sample_table$ici_score[i]

  ici_effect <- rep(1, length(families))
  names(ici_effect) <- families
  ici_effect[c("Lactobacillaceae", "Bifidobacteriaceae", "Oscillospiraceae")] <-
    0.70 + 1.45 * score
  ici_effect[c("Erysipelotrichaceae", "Lachnospiraceae")] <-
    1.15 - 0.35 * score

  shape <- pmax(
    0.24,
    base_shape * group_effect[group_name, ] * ici_effect *
      exp(rnorm(length(families), 0, 0.24))
  )

  abundance <- rgamma(length(families), shape = shape, rate = 1)
  abundance <- 100 * abundance / sum(abundance)

  data.frame(
    sample = sample_table$sample[i],
    sample_index = sample_table$sample_index[i],
    plot_x = sample_table$plot_x[i],
    group = group_name,
    replicate = sample_table$replicate[i],
    ici_score = score,
    family = families,
    relative_abundance = abundance
  )
})

abundance_data <- bind_rows(composition_list) |>
  mutate(
    family = factor(family, levels = families),
    group = factor(group, levels = diet_groups)
  )

group_midpoints <- sample_table |>
  group_by(group) |>
  summarise(midpoint = mean(plot_x), .groups = "drop")

write.csv(
  abundance_data,
  "synthetic_microbiome_abundance.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

head(abundance_data)
```

## Figure

```{r figure, fig.width=15.5, fig.height=7.6, out.width='100%'}
family_colours <- c(
  "Erysipelotrichaceae" = "#E9C46A",
  "Lachnospiraceae" = "#E76F8A",
  "Atopobiaceae" = "#4F9DA6",
  "Muribaculaceae" = "#A8DADC",
  "Akkermansiaceae" = "#E4572E",
  "Bacteroidaceae" = "#B8DE29",
  "Bifidobacteriaceae" = "#C77DA6",
  "Clostridiaceae" = "#738B3A",
  "Eubacterium_coprostanoligenes_group" = "#9C3FB1",
  "Lactobacillaceae" = "#665191",
  "Peptococcaceae" = "#D8D2C4",
  "Peptostreptococcaceae" = "#43AA8B",
  "Ruminococcaceae" = "#A47E2C",
  "Oscillospiraceae" = "#55C1B3",
  "Staphylococcaceae" = "#C62E65",
  "Streptococcaceae" = "#F07832",
  "Sutterellaceae" = "#C7C56C",
  "Others" = "#B9B3BA"
)

p <- ggplot(abundance_data) +
  geom_col(
    aes(
      x = plot_x,
      y = relative_abundance,
      fill = family
    ),
    position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE),
    width = 0.92,
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.10
  ) +
  annotate(
    "polygon",
    x = c(
      min(sample_table$plot_x) - 0.5,
      max(sample_table$plot_x) + 0.5,
      max(sample_table$plot_x) + 0.5
    ),
    y = c(102.7, 102.7, 112.0),
    fill = "#D5DEE5",
    colour = NA
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = max(sample_table$plot_x) - 0.4,
    y = 106.8,
    label = "ICI score",
    hjust = 1,
    size = 5.7,
    colour = "#263238"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = group_midpoints$midpoint,
    labels = group_midpoints$group,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.002, 0.002))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 113),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = family_colours,
    breaks = rev(families),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Relative abundance (%)",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      reverse = FALSE,
      ncol = 1,
      byrow = TRUE,
      keyheight = grid::unit(0.42, "cm"),
      keywidth = grid::unit(0.76, "cm")
    )
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 17) +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.8, colour = "#222222"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.7, colour = "#222222"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 90,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 0.5,
      size = 13.5,
      colour = "#222222",
      margin = margin(t = 7)
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13.5, colour = "#222222"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18, margin = margin(r = 13)),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12.5, colour = "#222222"),
    legend.key = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = NA),
    legend.spacing.y = grid::unit(0.02, "cm"),
    plot.margin = margin(14, 22, 15, 12)
  )

ggsave(
  "microbiome_relative_abundance.png",
  p,
  width = 15.5,
  height = 7.6,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

p
```
